area_note: Kota Kinabalu (KK), Sabah's capital, from Likas Bay and the Likas sports complex in the north of the city to Tanjung Aru in the south
intro: KK's runners gather mostly on the flat coastal path at Likas Bay, which has views of Mount Kinabalu, and use the loop at the Likas Sports Complex for interval and tempo sessions. The Universiti Malaysia Sabah (UMS) campus, Signal Hill and the steeper Bukit Botak trail are used for longer runs and hill work. Because of the heat and humidity, group runs cluster around sunrise (about 5.30-8am) or after 6.30pm, and local runners avoid the early afternoon. Kinabalu Running Club, which organises the Borneo International Marathon, publishes races and events rather than a weekly run schedule. Informal group runs are often arranged through WhatsApp groups and Strava.

clubs.name: Kinabalu Running Club (KRC)
clubs.description: A community running club founded in 2008 that organises the AIMS-sanctioned Borneo International Marathon every May and the Borneo Half Marathon, which it co-organises with Kota Kinabalu City Hall. It also holds fun runs, charity events and fitness initiatives around the city, including events at Taman Awam Teluk Likas.
clubs.active_evidence: The club's marathon site lists the Borneo International Marathon it organises for 7-10 May 2026

clubs.name: KSRun Athletic Club (Kinabalu Sabah Run)
clubs.description: A Kota Kinabalu athletics club that organises community road events in the city, including the Songkran Sunset Splash Run in April, the Ohana Run at the Likas sports complex in August and the North Borneo United Harmony Run, a 5km and 10km route past places of worship around the city, in November. It also posts on Facebook as Kinabalu Sabah Run.
clubs.active_evidence: Ohana Run held at Likas Complex, 2 Aug 2026; Harmony Run listed for 22 Nov 2026 at Padang Merdeka
